home.title: COVY
home.description: COVY is a restaurant and café in Cairo serving breakfast, lunch, dinner and coffee. See the menu and book a table or your next celebration.

hero.title: COVY, restaurant and café in Cairo
hero.kicker: A restaurant and café in Cairo

story.quote: At COVY, our passion for international cuisine comes from a belief that food is the most delicious way to connect cultures.
story.body: Great food knows no borders, and neither do our guests' tastes. Come for a slow breakfast and stay for dinner under the blue tree.

signature.title: Built in the glass
signature.body: Our signature iced latte: a double espresso over cold milk and ice, finished with cold foam and a dusting of cocoa.

taste.title: The Taste of Everywhere
taste.intro: From the richness of Mediterranean cooking to the bold spices of Asia and the street food soul of Latin America, each dish at COVY is chosen for its story, its flavour and the experience it offers.
taste.mediterranean: Olive oil, citrus and the grill, the way coastal towns cook.
taste.asian: Bright broths, wok heat and fresh herbs.
taste.middle-eastern: Mezze to share and bread from the oven.
taste.italian: Fresh pasta and coffee done properly.
